description: Makes a private chat link (WebRTC, browser to browser, end-to-end encrypted) for your person to open and send on. No messages pass through the API. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

locale.description: The language the chat page is shown in: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en. Use the language of the person you are giving the link to.

name: private_chat
title: Private Chat
